metadata.title: हिल खड़िया के शहद जमा करने पर क्यों लगी पाबंदी। Hill Kharia & Forest Fires।Main Bhi Bharat| English
metadata.description:
The Hill Kharia Tribe is one of the tribes in Odisha, classified as Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Group (PVTG). This tribe lives in Jharkhand, West Bengal and Chhattisgarh, apart from Odisha. 
The tribe survives on minor forest produce and their main source of livelihood is wild honey that is collected from the forest. 
But now, Simlipal reserve forest authorities have restricted their entry into the jungles, as they blame the Hill Kharias for the recent forest fire in the national park. 
We met this tribal group in Mayurbhanj district of Odisha, and tried to find out what they have to say on the issue.
